train: train the L2L model using a TensorFlow session, minimize operations, number of epochs, and number of unrolls
test_L2LTest: test the L2L TensorFlow implementation by running the simple problem test case
test_L2LTest_testSimple: test the L2L applied to a simple problem with MetaOptimizer and CoordinateWiseDeepLSTM network
create_MetaOptimizer: create a MetaOptimizer with CoordinateWiseDeepLSTM network and zero initializer for stable learning
run_tf_test: run the L2L test suite using TensorFlow test main entry point
